title: Google Pixel owners urged to patch actively exploited modem flaw
content_md: Google has released its September 2026 Pixel Update Bulletin , fixing 110 vulnerabilities, including one that it says “may be under limited, targeted exploitation.” The bug is not described as a simple remote takeover, but as a vulnerability that could give an attacker who already has a foothold on a phone more power than they should have. Although Pixel devices also run Android, they receive separate security updates and bug fixes from the standard monthly patches distributed to Android manufacturers because of the unique hardware platform Google controls directly and its exclusive features and capabilities. To apply this month’s security updates, Pixel users should go to Settings > Security & privacy > System & updates > Security update , tap Install , and restart their device to complete the update process. A supported device with the 2026-09-05 patch level is up to date. After updating, check that the Android security update level shows September 5, 2026 , or later.
